# superlog_alert (Resource)

A threshold alert on logs, spans, or a metric. While the value is past the threshold, the alert posts once to its Slack channel and posts the recovery in the same thread.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superlog_slack_channel" "alerts" {
  name = "alerts"
}

# More than 50 error logs from checkout in production in 5 minutes.
resource "superlog_alert" "checkout_errors" {
  name        = "Checkout errors"
  source      = "logs"
  aggregation = "count"
  comparator  = "gt"
  threshold   = 50
  filter = {
    service  = "checkout"
    severity = "ERROR"
    attributes = [
      { key = "deployment.environment", value = "production" },
    ]
  }
  slack = {
    channel_id             = data.superlog_slack_channel.alerts.channel_id
    integration_account_id = data.superlog_slack_channel.alerts.integration_account_id
  }
}

# p95 span duration above 750 ms, checked for each service.
resource "superlog_alert" "slow_services" {
  name           = "Slow services"
  source         = "traces"
  aggregation    = "p95"
  field          = "duration"
  comparator     = "gt"
  threshold      = 750
  window_minutes = 10
  group_mode     = "per_group"
  group_by       = "service.name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aggregation` (String) `count` counts matching logs or spans; `count_distinct`, `sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max`, `p50`, `p90`, `p95`, and `p99` read `field`. Metrics use `sum` or `avg`.
- `comparator` (String) `gt` fires when the value is above `threshold`, `lt` when it is below.
- `name` (String)
- `source` (String) `logs`, `traces` (spans), or `metric`.
- `threshold` (Number)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) A disabled alert is not checked. Defaults to `true`.
- `evaluation_interval_seconds` (Number) How often the alert is checked, from 60 to 3600 seconds. Defaults to 60.
- `field` (String) What a log or span aggregation other than `count` reads: `duration`, an attribute key, or an AI usage field such as `ai:cost`.
- `filter` (Attributes) Narrows the data the alert reads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `group_by` (String) The attribute key to split by when `group_mode` is `per_group`, such as `service.name`.
- `group_mode` (String) `single` checks one total. `per_group` checks each `group_by` value and fires for each one separately. Defaults to `single`.
- `metric_name` (String) The metric to read when `source` is `metric`.
- `slack` (Attributes) The Slack channel the alert posts to. Look it up with the `superlog_slack_channel` data source. Without one, the alert only records its history in Superlog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--slack))
- `window_minutes` (Number) How many minutes of data each check reads, from 1 to 1440. Defaults to 5.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `url` (String) The alert in Superlog.

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `attributes` (Attributes List) Attribute filters. A key may start with `resource.`, `span.`, `log.`, or `field.`; a bare key is a resource attribute. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--attributes))
- `metric_kind` (String) Picks one metric when its name is sent as several kinds.
- `metric_unit` (String) Picks one metric when its name is sent with several units.
- `min_duration_ms` (Number) Only spans at least this long.
- `service` (String)
- `severity` (String) Log severity, such as `ERROR`.
- `span_name` (String)
- `status_code` (String) Span status code, such as `ERROR`.

<a id="nestedatt--filter--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.attributes`

Required:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

Optional:

- `op` (String) `eq` (the default), `neq`, or `not_contains`.



<a id="nestedatt--slack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `slack`

Required:

- `channel_id` (String) The Slack channel ID.
- `integration_account_id` (String) The Superlog Slack integration the channel belongs to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an alert by its ID, from its URL in Superlog.
terraform import superlog_alert.checkout_errors 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
